obligations.behavior: a second heal of the same format is refused without a deviation id; heal agreement is computed on fit and selection records only and a test or held-out id in its input exits non-zero
obligations.source_text: heal the quantized model: a short distillation pass that trains the quantized student (or its LoRA/norms) against the bf16 distilled student's and Clef's soft labels, and the healed build must reach agreement >= 0.97 with the bf16 student on the Jetson-ops fit/selection folds before it can ship

obligations.behavior: docs name every file the bundle stage writes, its dtype/quant scheme and the loader entry point; a test fails when the bundle writes a file the doc does not list
obligations.source_text: lobes' orin-nano machine card, shape and quantized decider backend are a separate lobes plan, not jev-factory tasks; jev-factory fixes and documents the bundle format (file layout, quantization scheme, loader entry point) that plan consumes

obligations.behavior: a non-127.0.0.1 URL is refused; requests carry Authorization: Bearer from the env var named in config and X-Lobes-Model: decider:general; the key value never appears in a manifest, log or exception text
obligations.source_text: teacher-label reaches the Orin gateway through an SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1, so SystemOneClient's localhost-only guard (require_localhost) stays, and the client gains the gateway bearer key (env-var name only) and the X-Lobes-Model: decider:general header, which today it does not send

obligations.behavior: no stage opens a connection to any host other than 127.0.0.1; teacher labelling sends one request at a time
obligations.source_text: Clef 27B stays served only on the AGX Orin (W4A16); this work changes no other box's served model or shape, and the existing decider:strands-general on spark2 stays as the stock baseline

obligations.behavior: each bar is computed for both the bf16 student and the shipped quant with a paired bootstrap CI and cited against the hashed prereg; latency median and p95 are reported without a pass/fail
obligations.source_text: on the held-out human-gold Jetson-ops test set both the distilled bf16 student and the shipped healed quant beat the stock 2610 by >= 10 points top-1 and are within 5 points of Clef W4A16; the healed quant is < 1 GB of weights on disk and agrees >= 0.97 with the bf16 student; median and p95 latency on the AGX Orin and the Nano are measured and reported

obligations.behavior: with the 2610 manifest, a record from tasksource/tasksource-jev-typed-decisions or LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions is reported overlapping
obligations.source_text: the contamination check is retargeted to 2610: data/upstream_sources.json is regenerated from the 2610 model card at 216d1ccb (48 datasets, incl. tasksource/tasksource-jev-typed-decisions and tasksource/procedural-typed-decisions), so typed-decisions general-guard records are marked overlapping, not clean

obligations.behavior: stock 2610 on JevBench w4096 is recorded with n and CI; a result outside the card's 0.7792 CI stops the train stage until a deviation is recorded
obligations.source_text: before training, stock 2610 is served on the inferred base revision b1485b2 (provenance.json: 'inferred: Hub main at training time; hosts did not pin it') and must reproduce its own published JevBench w4096 result (eval/summary.json, 0.7792 = 180/231) within its CI; a miss stops the run as a base-mismatch

obligations.behavior: approving a drafted test record writes an append-only entry (record sha256, decision, time); final refuses any test record without a matching approved entry
obligations.source_text: a record counts as human gold only with an operator approval record (record sha256, decision, timestamp) written by a jev review gold-approval path; agent-drafted test records are stored as proposed and the final stage refuses a test record without a matching approval (records.py gold_provenance is a free string today)

obligations.behavior: a question with more than 24 options or a record over 4096 student tokens is refused and counted by reason; none is truncated
obligations.source_text: every Jetson-ops question offers at most 24 options (strands_decider_config.json num_slots = 24) and fits max_length 4096; the dataset stage refuses, never truncates, a record that exceeds either

obligations.behavior: upload refuses when scan-secrets, the hostname/IP scan or the side-model-name scan hits, or when the Clef probe set is present; it prints file and line only
obligations.source_text: the dataset bundle never contains the Clef probe set (private) and passes scripts/scan-secrets.py plus a hostname/IP and side-model-name scan before upload; evidence-derived records are redacted at draft time

obligations.behavior: the pruned-vocabulary build is recorded with its kept id list and is reported beside the full-vocabulary quant (weight bytes, selection-fold accuracy, count of records refused for out-of-vocabulary tokens); it is never selected as the shipped build
obligations.source_text: a pruned-vocabulary build (bf16 or quantized embedding over the ids the Jetson-ops and general prompts use, 32-50k) is also built as a comparison: it is measured beside the full-vocabulary quant on size, accuracy and out-of-vocabulary refusals, reported only; the full-vocabulary quant stays the shipped build
